The competition was organized by the [[Ligue Nationale du Football Amateur]] and consisted of two groups of 16. At the end of the last day of Ligue 2, the 3 clubs ranked last in each group are relegated to the Inter Régions. The start of the 2024–25 season of the Ligue 2 was àn Friday, September 20, as announced by [[Ligue Nationale du Football Amateur]] in a press release published on the official website.{{cite web |url=https://footalgerien.com/ligue-2-coup-denvoi-de-la-nouvelle-saison-le-20-septembre/ |title=Ligue 2 : Coup d’envoi de la nouvelle saison le 20 septembre |website=Foot Algerien |date=2 August 2024 |access-date=2 September 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://lnfa.dz/2024/08/01/le-calendrier-du-championnat-de-ligue-2-2024-2025/ |title=Le calendrier du championnat de Ligue 2 2024/2025 |website=LNFA |date=1 August 2024 |access-date=30 August 2024}} ==Teams== [[US Souf]] and [[ES Ben Aknoun]] were relegated from [[Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1]].
